rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ура! Смотри́те, санки едут сами!
rows.text: Yay! Look, the sled goes by itself!
rows.heard: Yay, look, the sled goes by itself.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вжух! И мои едут! Сами!
rows.text: Whoosh! Mine too! By itself!
rows.heard: whoosh mine too by itself.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ох, наверх тяжело! А вниз — легко!
rows.text: Oof, going up is hard! Going down is easy!
rows.heard: Oof going up is hard, going down is easy.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Внизу санки остановились. А наверх их надо тащить.
rows.text: Down there, the sleds stopped. Up, you have to pull them.
rows.heard: Down there the sled stopped. Up you have to pull them.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Рон, санки хитрые. Вниз едут, а наверх ленятся!
rows.text: Ron, sleds are sneaky. Down they go, but up they're lazy!
rows.heard: Ron's sleds are sneaky. Down they go, but up they're lazy.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: С горки санки едут сами. А в гору — нет. Почему так? Вот это загадка!
rows.text: Down the hill the sled goes by itself. But not up the hill. Why? What a mystery!
rows.heard: Down the hill the sled goes by itself, but not up the hill. Why would a mystery?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я знаю! У санок внутри моторчик!
rows.text: I know! The sled has a motor!
rows.heard: I know, the sled has a motor.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Никакого моторчика. Только дощечки и полозья.
rows.text: No motor at all. Just boards and runners.
rows.heard: No motor at all. Just boards and runners.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже батарейки нет?
rows.text: Not even batteries?
rows.heard: Not even batteries.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Даже батарейки.
rows.text: Not even batteries.
rows.heard: Not even batteries.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А может, их толкает ветер?
rows.text: Maybe the wind pushes them?
rows.heard: Maybe the wind pushes them.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Сейчас ветра нет. Тихо-тихо.
rows.text: There's no wind now. It's quiet.
rows.heard: There's no wind now, it's quiet.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: И внизу санки стоят. Сами никуда не едут.
rows.text: At the bottom, the sleds just stand. They don't move.
rows.heard: At the bottom, the sleds just stand. They don't move.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, им нужна горка. Горка — это волшебство!
rows.text: So they need a hill. The hill is magic!
rows.heard: So they need a hill. The hill is magic.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте проверим на ровном месте. Без горки.
rows.text: Let's test it on flat ground. With no hill.
rows.heard: Let's test it on flat ground with no hill.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: По ровному тоже надо тащить. Но легче, чем в гору.
rows.text: On flat ground you have to pull too. But it's easier than uphill.
rows.heard: On flat ground you have to pull too, but it's easier than uphill.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Проехали чуть-чуть. И встали!
rows.text: It went a little bit. And stopped!
rows.heard: It went a little bit and stopped.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Снег их держит. Как будто тормозит.
rows.text: The snow holds them. Like a brake.
rows.heard: The snow holds them like a break.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А если толкнуть сильно-сильно?
rows.text: What if I push really, really hard?
rows.heard: What if I push really, really hard?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Санки уехали. А я остался.
rows.text: The sled left. I stayed.
rows.heard: The sled left, I stayed.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Санки проехали дальше. Но всё равно встали.
rows.text: The sled went farther. But it still stopped.
rows.heard: The sled went farther, but it still stopped.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Значит, сами они едут только с горки. Вниз.
rows.text: So they only go by themselves down a hill. Downward.
rows.heard: so they only go by themselves down a hill, downward.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А почему только вниз?
rows.text: But why only down?
rows.heard: But why only downed?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Пока не знаю. Проверим ещё!
rows.text: I don't know yet. Let's test more!
rows.heard: I don't know yet. Let's test more.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Смотри́те! Я прыгну высоко-высоко. До самого неба!
rows.text: Look! I'll jump high, high up. All the way to the sky!
rows.heard: Look I'll jump high, high up, all the way to the sky.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Прыгнул вверх. И сразу вниз!
rows.text: He jumped up. And right back down!
rows.heard: He jumped up and right back down.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: До неба не долетел. Что-то тянет меня назад.
rows.text: I didn't reach the sky. Something pulls me back.
rows.heard: I didn't reach the sky, something pulls me back.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Топа тоже не любит летать наверх. Как санки!
rows.text: Topa doesn't like flying up either. Just like the sled!
rows.heard: Topa doesn't like flying up either, just like the sled.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: И снежинки падают вниз. И снег на горке лежит, не улетает.
rows.text: Snowflakes fall down too. And the snow stays on the hill.
rows.heard: Snow flakes fall down too, and the snow stays on the hill.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я проверю сам. Побегу на горку без санок!
rows.text: I'll check myself. I'll run up without a sled!
rows.heard: I'll check myself. I'll run up without a sled.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я тоже скатился вниз. Сам! Без санок!
rows.text: I rolled down too. By myself! Without a sled!
rows.heard: I rolled down too, by myself without a sled.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, ты как снежный колобок!
rows.text: Ron, you're like a rolling snowball!
rows.heard: Roman, you're like a rolling snowball.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Топа, снежинки, санки и Рон. Все летят вниз. Кто же тянет всех вниз?
rows.text: Topa, the snowflakes, the sled and Ron. Everyone goes down. Who pulls them all down?
rows.heard: Topa, the snowflakes, the sled, and Ron, everyone goes down, who pulls them all down.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот наш снеговик! Он стои́т на горке.
rows.text: Here's our snowman! He's standing on the hill.
rows.heard: Here's our snowman. He's standing on the hill.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А почему снеговик с горки не едет? Он же тоже на горке!
rows.text: But why doesn't the snowman slide down? He's on the hill too!
rows.heard: But why doesn't the snowman slide down? He's on the hill too.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Он стои́т в снегу, как в валенках. Снег его держит.
rows.text: He's standing in the snow, like in boots. The snow holds him.
rows.heard: He's standing in the snow, like in boots. The snow holds him.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А санки снизу гладкие. Они скользят по снегу.
rows.text: But sleds are smooth underneath. They slide on the snow.
rows.heard: But sleds are smooth underneath. They slide on the snow.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Гладкие скользят. Но кто их тянет вниз? Пока загадка.
rows.text: Smooth things slide. But who pulls them down? It's still a mystery.
rows.heard: Smooth things slide, but who pulls them down? It's still a mystery.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я сделаю снеговику санки! Пусть тоже катается!
rows.text: Then I'll make the snowman a sled! Let him ride too!
rows.heard: Then I'll make the snowman a sled. Let him ride too.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, снеговик боится скорости!
rows.text: Ron, the snowman is scared of speed!
rows.heard: Run, the snowman is scared of speed.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ладно. Пусть стои́т и смотрит, как мы катаемся.
rows.text: Okay. He can stand and watch us ride.
rows.heard: Okay, he can stand and watch us ride.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Пойдёмте греться. Там подумаем.
rows.text: Let's go warm up. We'll think there.
rows.heard: Let's go warm up. We'll think there.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотри́те, чай льётся вниз. Из чайника в чашку.
rows.text: Look, the tea pours down. From the teapot into the cup.
rows.heard: Look the tea pours down, from the teapot into the cup.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А вверх он не льётся?
rows.text: Doesn't it pour up?
rows.heard: Doesn't it pour up?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Никогда. Только вниз.
rows.text: Never. Only down.
rows.heard: to never only down.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Вкусно. И тепло.
rows.text: Yummy. And warm.
rows.heard: Yummy and warm.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А я думаю, санки просто любят кататься. Как мы!
rows.text: I think sleds just love to ride. Like us!
rows.heard: I think sleds just love to ride, like us.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Может быть. Но наверх они не хотят.
rows.text: Maybe. But they don't want to go up.
rows.heard: Maybe, but they don't want to go up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Может, внизу живёт великан? И всех тянет к себе. Как магнит!
rows.text: Maybe a giant lives down below? And pulls everyone to himself. Like a magnet!
rows.heard: Maybe a giant lives down below and pulls everyone to himself, like a magnet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Великана нет. Но ты почти угадал, Рон.
rows.text: There's no giant. But you almost guessed it, Ron.
rows.heard: There's no giant, but you almost guessed it wrong.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Почти? Кто же тогда тянет?
rows.text: Almost? Then who pulls?
rows.heard: Almost then he pulls.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Пойдёмте в комнату. Я нарисую, и всё станет понятно.
rows.text: Let's go to the room. I'll draw it, and everything will be clear.
rows.heard: Let's go to the room. I'll draw it and everything will be clear.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Это горка. А это земля внизу. Наша Земля очень большая. И она тянет к себе всё. Это называется притяжение.
rows.text: This is the hill. And this is the ground below. Our Earth is very big. And it pulls everything toward itself. That's called gravity.
rows.heard: This is the hill, and this is the ground below. Our Earth is very big, and it pulls everything toward itself. That's called gravity.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Земля тянет? А рук у неё нет!
rows.text: The Earth pulls? It has no hands!
rows.heard: The earth pulls, it has no hands.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рук нет. А тянет всегда. И снежинки, и чай, и санки. И даже нас.
rows.text: No hands. But it always pulls. Snowflakes, tea and sleds. And even us.
rows.heard: No hands, but it always pulls. Snowflakes tea and sleds and even us.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Поэтому я не улетаю, когда прыгаю?
rows.text: Is that why I don't fly away when I jump?
rows.heard: Is that why I don't fly away when I jump?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да! Прыгнул — и сразу вниз.
rows.text: Yes! Jump up, and right back down.
rows.heard: Yes, jump up and right back down.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Санки на горке тоже тянет вниз Земля. Поэтому с горки они едут сами!
rows.text: The Earth pulls the sled down too. So it goes down the hill by itself!
rows.heard: The Earth pulls the sled down too, so it goes down the hill by itself.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А в гору?
rows.text: And uphill?
rows.heard: and uphill.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: В гору санки надо тянуть против притяжения. Земля тянет их назад, вниз. Поэтому тяжело.
rows.text: Uphill, you pull the sled against gravity. The Earth pulls it back, down. That's why it's hard.
rows.heard: Up hill you pull the sled against gravity. The Earth pulls it back down. That's why it's hard.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А снег гладкий и скользкий. Санки по нему легко скользят.
rows.text: And the snow is smooth and slippery. Sleds slide on it easily.
rows.heard: and the snow is smooth and slippery. Sled slide on it easily.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А на ровном месте?
rows.text: And on flat ground?
rows.heard: and on flat ground.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: На ровном месте вниз некуда. Снег немножко тормозит. И санки стоят.
rows.text: On flat ground, there's no down. The snow brakes a bit. So the sled stands.
rows.heard: On flat ground, there's no down, the snow breaks a bit, so the sled stands.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, Земля любит, когда мы катаемся с горки!
rows.text: So the Earth loves it when we ride down the hill!
rows.heard: So the earth loves it when we ride down the hill.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А я тяжёлый. Меня Земля тянет сильнее?
rows.text: And I'm heavy. Does the Earth pull me harder?
rows.heard: And I'm heavy, does the earth pull me harder?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да, Топа. Тяжёлого тянет сильнее. А пёрышко — совсем чуть-чуть.
rows.text: Yes, Topa. It pulls heavy things harder. And a little feather just a tiny bit.
rows.heard: Yes, Topa, it pulls heavy things harder, and a little feather just a tiny bit.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я съем ещё пирожок. И поеду быстрее всех!
rows.text: Then I'll eat one more pie. And go faster than everyone!
rows.heard: Then I'll eat one more pie, and go faster than everyone.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Проверим! Чем выше горка, тем быстрее едешь.
rows.text: Let's test it! The higher the hill, the faster you go.
rows.heard: Let's test it. The higher the hill, the faster you go.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Ура-а-а! Как быстро!
rows.text: Yaaay! So fast!
rows.heard: Yelly so fast.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Земля, спасибо!
rows.text: Thank you, Earth!
rows.heard: Thank you, Earth.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Мы вместе! И оба сами!
rows.text: Together! Both by ourselves!
rows.heard: Together both by ourselves.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Видите? Санки едут туда, куда тянет Земля.
rows.text: See? The sleds go where the Earth pulls.
rows.heard: See, the sleds go where the earth pulls.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Теперь я тащу санки наверх. Сам!
rows.text: Now I'll pull the sled up. By myself!
rows.heard: Now I'll pull the sled up by myself.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Наверх тяжело. Земля тянет санки назад!
rows.text: Going up is hard. The Earth pulls the sled back!
rows.heard: Going up is hard, the Earth pulls the sled back.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А вниз она мне помогает!
rows.text: But going down, it helps me!
rows.heard: But going down, it helps me.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Ура! Я тоже еду!
rows.text: Yay! I'm riding too!
rows.heard: Yay, I'm riding too.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Пик маленький, а едет быстро!
rows.text: Pik is little, but he goes fast!
rows.heard: Pick is little, but he goes fast.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Земля тянет всех: и маленьких, и больших.
rows.text: The Earth pulls everyone: little ones and big ones.
rows.heard: The Earth pulls everyone, little ones and big ones.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Последний раз! Кто быстрее?
rows.text: One last time! Who's faster?
rows.heard: one last time who's faster.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ничья! Оба приехали вместе!
rows.text: A tie! You both got here together!
rows.heard: A tie you both got here together.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Я тяжёлый, а Барсик лёгкий. А приехали вместе!
rows.text: I'm heavy, and Barsik is light. But we got here together!
rows.heard: I'm heavy and Barsick is light, but we got here together.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Земля тянет каждого. Поэтому едут почти одинаково.
rows.text: The Earth pulls each one. That's why they go almost the same.
rows.heard: The Earth pulls each one, that's why they go almost the same.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я буду судьёй. Я снизу всё видел!
rows.text: I'll be the judge. I saw it all!
rows.heard: I'll be the judge, I saw it all.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотри́те, со́лнце садится. Пора домой.
rows.text: Look, the sun is setting. Time to go home.
rows.heard: Look the sun is setting. Time to go home.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Домой санки тоже надо тащить. Тут ровно.
rows.text: The sled has to be pulled home too. It's flat here.
rows.heard: The sled has to be pulled home too. It's flat here.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Топа, ты как паровозик! Ту-ту!
rows.text: Topa, you're a little train! Choo-choo!
rows.heard: Topa, you're a little train. Choo choo.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Сегодня мы узнали секрет горки.
rows.text: Today we learned the secret of the hill.
rows.heard: Today we learned the secret of the hill.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Земля тянет всё вниз. Даже санки.
rows.text: The Earth pulls everything down. Even sleds.
rows.heard: The Earth pulls everything down, even sleds.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я узнал, что катиться без санок тоже весело!
rows.text: And I learned that rolling without a sled is fun too!
rows.heard: And I learned that rolling without a sled is fun too.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Земля тянет всё вниз. Поэтому с горки едешь сам. В гору надо тащить. На ровном месте снег тормозит.
rows.text: The Earth pulls everything down. So you ride down by yourself. Uphill, you pull. On flat ground, snow brakes.
rows.heard: The Earth pulls everything down, so you ride down by yourself. Up hill you pull, on flat ground, snow breaks.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я запишу ещё: на горке очень весело!
rows.text: I'll add: the hill is so much fun!
rows.heard: I'll add, the hill is so much fun.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: И падать в снег мягко.
rows.text: And snow is soft to fall in.
rows.heard: and snow is soft to fall in.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Особенно Рону. Он сегодня падал целых три раза!
rows.text: Especially for Ron. He fell three whole times today!
rows.heard: Especially for Ran, he fell three whole times today.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Это я проверял притяжение.
rows.text: I was testing gravity.
rows.heard: I was testing gravity.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ой, как спать хочется. Накатались мы сегодня!
rows.text: Oh, I'm so sleepy. We rode so much today!
rows.heard: Oh, I'm so sleepy. We rode so much today.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А на небе уже́ звёзды. Много-много!
rows.text: There are stars in the sky now. Lots of them!
rows.heard: There are stars in the sky now, lots of them.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А днём их не было. Куда звёзды прячутся днём?
rows.text: They weren't there in the daytime. Where do stars hide during the day?
rows.heard: They weren't there in the daytime, or do stars hide during the day?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот это загадка! Завтра узнаем!
rows.text: What a mystery! We'll find out tomorrow!
rows.heard: What a mystery we'll find out tomorrow.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Ти́ше. Топа уже́ спит.
rows.text: Shh. Topa's already asleep.
rows.heard: SHH, Tope is already asleep.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу поставить лайк и подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
